test_resolve_none_prompt: test the DiffGenerator._resolve_prompts method returns [" "] when prompt is None
test_resolve_string_prompt: test the DiffGenerator._resolve_prompts method returns a single-element list for a string prompt
test_resolve_list_prompt: test the DiffGenerator._resolve_prompts method returns the list unchanged for a list prompt
test_resolve_prompt_from_file: test the DiffGenerator._resolve_prompts method reads prompts from a file via prompt_path argument
test_resolve_prompt_error_cases: test the DiffGenerator._resolve_prompts method raises FileNotFoundError for missing files and ValueError for empty files
